if you want to see the significance of Round numbers, for example you
can apply this to you AUDCAD chart: draw all the line from the round
numbers like 0.90, 0.91, 0.92,..., 1.05, 1.06, 1.07 ....

you can see that they seem amazing, price really respected them many times and sometimes to the pip!

but in terms of trading, i think they can be important but not reliable for an accurate entry, stop and even target!
